notes: Round 0 verdict is REVISE because of 2 hard violations (V1, V2) and 4 judgment violations (V3-V6). The linter passed on the LinkedIn text, the Instagram caption and the hashtags: no hard failures and no soft flags. verify_quotes found all 5 source quotes the draft relies on (F1, F4, F5, F6, F11). Facts used: 5 on LinkedIn and 4 on Instagram, both within the limits. The draft lists no definitions and maps nothing to DEF. The draft keeps the hedges ('roughly 6,000', 'more than 300 deployments'), the attributions to The Next Web and MIT NANDA, and the date of each move. It adds no vendor figures that are not in the brief and does not add the figures up. It has no expired call to action. The earned phrases ('Name the job / Fit the workflow / Own the handoff / Prove the number', 'Buy the help, keep the muscle') are protected. The F4 sentence on both platforms carries three violations (V3-V6). The suggested replacement fixes all of them at once: 'The companies selling the models put money into people because customers who got the model alone did not see it in their numbers.'
